es: Reconocer cuándo una decisión pasada explica una situación presente con condicionales mixtos (If I had…, I would… now).

teaching.en: If I had accepted the offer, I would be living abroad now.
teaching.es: Si hubiera aceptado la oferta, ahora estaría viviendo en el extranjero.
teaching.explanationEs: If + had + participio mira al pasado; would + verbo base, al presente.
segments: If I had accepted the offer,
I would be living abroad now.
teaching.audioText: If I had accepted the offer, I would be living abroad now.

teaching.en: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor today.
teaching.es: Si hubiera estudiado medicina, hoy sería médica.
teaching.explanationEs: Today marca el resultado en el presente.
segments: If she had studied medicine, she
would be a doctor today.
teaching.audioText: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor today.

teaching.en: If they hadn't made that decision, they wouldn't have this career now.
teaching.es: Si no hubieran tomado esa decisión, ahora no tendrían esta carrera.
teaching.explanationEs: La negativa usa hadn't en la condición y wouldn't en el resultado.
segments: If they hadn't made that decision,
they wouldn't have this career now.
teaching.audioText: If they hadn't made that decision, they wouldn't have this career now.

teaching.en: If Leo had finished his degree, he would have a better job now.
teaching.es: Si Leo hubiera terminado su carrera, ahora tendría un mejor trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: Would have a better job now: would + verbo base, sin participio.
segments: If Leo had finished his degree, he
would have a better job now.
teaching.audioText: If Leo had finished his degree, he would have a better job now.

teaching.en: If you had listened to my advice, you wouldn't regret it now.
teaching.es: Si hubieras escuchado mi consejo, ahora no te arrepentirías.
teaching.explanationEs: El efecto actual (regret) va en presente con would.
segments: If you had listened to my
advice, you wouldn't regret it now.
teaching.audioText: If you had listened to my advice, you wouldn't regret it now.

teaching.en: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would be working in her father's shop instead.
teaching.es: Si Ana no se hubiera ido al extranjero, estaría trabajando en la tienda de su padre.
teaching.explanationEs: Instead = «en su lugar»: la alternativa que no ocurrió.
segments: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would
be working in her father's shop instead.
teaching.audioText: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would be working in her father's shop instead.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la decisión pasada de Sam con su situación actual.

choices.text: If Sam takes the job, he will live in Paris.
If Sam had taken the job, he would live in Paris now.
If Sam took the job, he would have lived in Paris.

feedback.es: La decisión es pasada (no tomó el trabajo) y el efecto es actual: If + had + participio, would + verbo base + now.

hint.es: Busca had + participio en la condición y would + verbo base en el resultado.

origin.text: Sam did not take the job in Paris. Today he lives in a small town.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si hubiera estudiado más, ahora tendría un mejor trabajo.»

answer.text: had

feedback.es: La condición mira al pasado irreal, así que lleva had + participio: If I had studied.

hint.es: Es el auxiliar que va delante del participio en la condición.

origin.text: If I ___ studied more, I would have a better job now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si hubiera aceptado la oferta, ahora viviría en el extranjero.»

answer.text: If I had accepted the offer, I would live abroad now.

feedback.es: Primero la condición pasada con coma; después el resultado presente con would.

hint.es: La condición va primero, con coma; el resultado acaba con now.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada condicional con la situación real que explica.

choices.text: If Ana misses the bus, she will be at home.
If Ana hadn't missed the bus, she would be at work now.
If Ana had missed the bus, she would be at work now.

feedback.es: Perdió el bus (pasado) y sigue en casa (presente): si no lo hubiera perdido, estaría en el trabajo.

accepted: If Ana had listened to her brother's advice, she wouldn't regret it now.
If Ana had listened to her brother, she wouldn't regret it now.

If I had stayed in school, I would have had a better job now.
If I had stayed in school, I would have a better job now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si hubieran seguido mi consejo, ahora no se arrepentirían.»

answer.text: If they had followed my advice, they wouldn't regret it now.

feedback.es: La condición pasada (had followed) explica el presente (wouldn't regret).

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no se hubiera roto la pierna, hoy estaría jugando la final.»

answer.text: today

feedback.es: Today marca un resultado presente: por eso se usa would be playing y no would have played.

origin.text: If he hadn't broken his leg, he would be playing in the final ___.

title.es: Dos tiempos en una misma oración

es: Formar condicionales mixtos en las dos direcciones y usar la inversión Had I… y If it weren't for…

teaching.en: If I had saved more money, I would be able to buy a car now.
teaching.es: Si hubiera ahorrado más dinero, ahora podría comprar un coche.
teaching.explanationEs: 3 → 2: condición pasada (had saved) y resultado presente (would be able to).
segments: If I had saved more money, I would
be able to buy a car now.
teaching.audioText: If I had saved more money, I would be able to buy a car now.

teaching.en: If I were taller, I would have joined the football team last year.
teaching.es: Si fuera más alto, me habría unido al equipo de fútbol el año pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: 2 → 3: un rasgo de hoy (were) explica un resultado pasado (would have joined).
segments: If I were taller, I would have
joined the football team last year.
teaching.audioText: If I were taller, I would have joined the football team last year.

teaching.en: If it weren't for the rain, we would be at the beach now.
teaching.es: De no ser por la lluvia, ahora estaríamos en la playa.
teaching.explanationEs: If it weren't for + nombre = «de no ser por» (hoy).
segments: If it weren't for the rain, we
would be at the beach now.
teaching.audioText: If it weren't for the rain, we would be at the beach now.

teaching.en: If it weren't for my brother, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
teaching.es: De no ser por mi hermano, no habría aprobado el examen.
teaching.explanationEs: If it weren't for también puede explicar un resultado pasado.
segments: If it weren't for my brother,
I wouldn't have passed the exam.
teaching.audioText: If it weren't for my brother, I wouldn't have passed the exam.

teaching.en: Had I known about the exam, I would have studied harder.
teaching.es: De haberlo sabido, habría estudiado más.
teaching.explanationEs: Had I known = If I had known: inversión, sin if y con had delante del sujeto.
segments: Had I known about the exam,
I would have studied harder.
teaching.audioText: Had I known about the exam, I would have studied harder.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une el rasgo de hoy de Sam con lo que no pasó el año pasado.

choices.text: If Sam had been taller, he would join the team.
If Sam is taller, he would have joined the team.
If Sam were taller, he would have joined the team.

feedback.es: Sam es bajo hoy (2) y no se unió el año pasado (3): If + were, would have + participio.

hint.es: Un rasgo de hoy explica algo que no pasó antes: if + pasado, would have + participio.

origin.text: Sam is short. He didn't join the football team last year.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si yo fuera más fuerte, habría ganado la carrera.»

answer.text: were

feedback.es: Para el presente irreal se usa were, también con I: If I were stronger.

hint.es: Es la forma de be que sigue a if en el presente irreal.

origin.text: If I ___ stronger, I would have won the race.

prompt.es: Ordena la inversión: «De haberlo sabido, habría estudiado más.»

answer.text: Had I known, I would have studied more.

feedback.es: Hay que empezar con Had, sin if: Had I known equivale a If I had known.

hint.es: Empieza con el auxiliar had, sin if.

If Mia hadn't been afraid of water, she would go on the trip.

es: Escuchar y leer una entrevista sobre un cambio de rumbo y extraer la decisión, la alternativa imaginada y el efecto actual.

teaching.en: Carlos quit his job at the bank ten years ago and opened a bakery.
teaching.es: Carlos dejó su trabajo en el banco hace diez años y abrió una panadería.
teaching.explanationEs: Decisión pasada: pasado simple (quit, opened) y una marca como ten years ago.
segments: Carlos quit his job at the bank
ten years ago and opened a bakery.
teaching.audioText: Carlos quit his job at the bank ten years ago and opened a bakery.

teaching.en: If he had stayed at the bank, he would be earning more money now.
teaching.es: Si se hubiera quedado en el banco, ahora estaría ganando más dinero.
teaching.explanationEs: Alternativa imaginada: If + had + participio, would + verbo base.
segments: If he had stayed at the bank,
he would be earning more money now.
teaching.audioText: If he had stayed at the bank, he would be earning more money now.

teaching.en: But he says he would be stressed, and he wouldn't have time for his family.
teaching.es: Pero dice que estaría estresado y que no tendría tiempo para su familia.
teaching.explanationEs: Stressed = estresado; el efecto actual de la alternativa.
segments: But he says he would be stressed, and
he wouldn't have time for his family.
teaching.audioText: But he says he would be stressed, and he wouldn't have time for his family.

teaching.en: If he hadn't taken that course, he wouldn't have his own bakery today.
teaching.es: Si no hubiera hecho ese curso, hoy no tendría su propia panadería.
teaching.explanationEs: Un condicional mixto: pasado que explica el presente.
segments: If he hadn't taken that course, he
wouldn't have his own bakery today.
teaching.audioText: If he hadn't taken that course, he wouldn't have his own bakery today.

teaching.en: For Carlos, the new path was worth it, and he is proud of his decision.
teaching.es: Para Carlos, el nuevo camino valió la pena y está orgulloso de su decisión.
teaching.explanationEs: Worth it = «valió la pena»; proud of + nombre.
segments: For Carlos, the new path was worth it,
and he is proud of his decision.
teaching.audioText: For Carlos, the new path was worth it, and he is proud of his decision.

prompt.es: En esta entrevista, ¿cuál fue la decisión pasada de Carlos?

choices.text: He quit his job at the bank.
He opened a bank.
He started a new course.

feedback.es: La decisión es lo que hizo hace diez años: quit his job at the bank.

hint.es: La decisión es lo que hizo «hace diez años»: busca el verbo en pasado.

origin.text: Carlos: Ten years ago I quit my job at the bank. I was very stressed, and I wanted a new path.

prompt.es: ¿Qué habría pasado hoy si Carlos se hubiera quedado en el banco?

choices.text: He would have a bakery.
He would earn more but be stressed.
He would have more free time.

feedback.es: La parte con if es la alternativa imaginada: ganaría más, pero estaría estresado.

hint.es: Lee la parte con if: es la alternativa imaginaria.

origin.text: Carlos: If I had stayed at the bank, I would be earning more now, but I would be stressed.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ahora tengo mi propia panadería y valió la pena.»

answer.text: worth

feedback.es: It was worth it = «valió la pena»: worth va antes de it.

hint.es: Es la palabra que sigue a «it was» para decir que algo valió la pena.

origin.text: Carlos: Now I have my own bakery, and it was ___ it.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el efecto actual de la decisión de la mujer.

choices.text: She lives near her parents.
She works for her father.
She has her own company in her new country.

feedback.es: El efecto actual es lo que tiene ahora: su propia empresa en el nuevo país; vivir cerca de sus padres era la alternativa.

origin.audio: I left my country at twenty. If I had stayed, I would be living near my parents now. But here I have my own company.

prompt.es: ¿Qué haría Elena hoy si no se hubiera mudado?

choices.text: She would be working in an office.
She would be teaching music.
She would be living in Lima.

feedback.es: La alternativa imaginada es trabajar en una oficina; enseñar música es lo que hace hoy.

origin.text: Interviewer: Why did you move to Lima? Elena: I accepted a job three years ago. If I had stayed in Madrid, I would be working in an office now. Here I teach music, and I love it.

prompt.es: Ordena lo que dice Carlos: «Si no hubiera hecho ese curso, hoy no tendría mi panadería.»

answer.text: If I hadn't taken that course, I wouldn't have my own bakery today.

feedback.es: La decisión (taken that course) explica el efecto actual (wouldn't have my own bakery today).

prompt.es: Según Tom, ¿qué sería hoy si no hubiera dejado la carrera?

choices.text: A chef.
An engineer.
A teacher.

feedback.es: La alternativa es la frase con if: si no hubiera dejado la carrera, sería ingeniero.

origin.text: Tom: I studied engineering for two years, but I hated it. Then I quit and started a cooking course. If I hadn't quit, I would be an engineer now. Today I'm a chef, and I'm proud of my decision.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué habría pasado si Sara hubiera seguido en la tienda.

choices.text: She would be teaching children.
She would be living abroad.
She would be very tired and not happy.

feedback.es: La frase con if dice lo que pasaría hoy en la tienda: cansada e infeliz; enseñar niños es su vida actual.

origin.audio: Sara quit her job in a shop five years ago. If she had stayed, she would be tired and unhappy now. Today she teaches children.

prompt.es: Clasifica cada frase de Mia: decisión, alternativa o efecto actual.

pairs: Mia left her job in a shop in 2019.
If Mia had stayed, she would be tired now.
Today Mia has her own restaurant.

feedback.es: La decisión va en pasado simple, la alternativa lleva if + had + participio y el efecto actual usa today o now.

pairs: Mia left her job in a shop in 2019.
If Mia had stayed, she would be tired now.
Today Mia has her own restaurant.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cambié de rumbo y no me arrepiento. Fue la mejor decisión de mi vida.»

answer.text: decision

feedback.es: Decision es la palabra que resume la elección: the best decision of my life.

origin.text: Elena: I changed my path five years ago, and I have no regrets. It was the best ___ of my life.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es el efecto actual de la decisión de Leo?

choices.text: He is a happy teacher.
He is unhappy at his old job.
He is looking for a new job.

feedback.es: El efecto actual es lo que dice que es hoy: un profesor feliz. La alternativa era ser infeliz en el trabajo antiguo.

origin.text: Leo: I hated my old job. If I had stayed, I would be unhappy now. But I changed, and today I'm a happy teacher.

prompt.es: Ordena la pregunta de la entrevistadora: «¿Por qué dejó usted su trabajo en el banco?»

answer.text: Why did you quit your job at the bank?

feedback.es: La pregunta por la decisión pasada usa did + sujeto + verbo base: Why did you quit…?

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no se hubiera ido al extranjero, ahora estaría trabajando en una tienda.»

answer.text: abroad

feedback.es: Abroad = en el extranjero: la decisión pasada (moved abroad) explica por qué hoy no trabaja en la tienda.

origin.text: If she hadn't moved ___, she would be working in a shop now.

es: Explicar con condicionales mixtos cómo una decisión pasada cambió tu presente y qué sería distinto, con la razón de cada decisión.

teaching.en: I chose to study art. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.
teaching.es: Elegí estudiar arte. Si no hubiera elegido arte, ahora no sería diseñadora.
teaching.explanationEs: Decisión + condicional 3 → 2 sobre lo que serías hoy.
segments: I chose to study art. If I hadn't
chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.
teaching.audioText: I chose to study art. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.

teaching.en: The reason was simple: I wanted to live near my family.
teaching.es: La razón era sencilla: quería vivir cerca de mi familia.
teaching.explanationEs: The reason was… introduce el porqué de la decisión.
segments: The reason was simple: I wanted
to live near my family.
teaching.audioText: The reason was simple: I wanted to live near my family.

teaching.en: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job. If I were more confident, I would have applied.
teaching.es: Soy tímida, así que no solicité el trabajo. Si fuera más segura, lo habría solicitado.
teaching.explanationEs: Rasgo de hoy (2) + resultado pasado (3): if + were, would have + participio.
segments: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job.
If I were more confident, I would have applied.
teaching.audioText: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job. If I were more confident, I would have applied.

teaching.en: I took the job; otherwise, I would still be looking for work now.
teaching.es: Acepté el trabajo; de lo contrario, aún estaría buscando empleo.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise introduce lo que pasaría de no haber decidido así.
segments: I took the job; otherwise, I would
still be looking for work now.
teaching.audioText: I took the job; otherwise, I would still be looking for work now.

teaching.en: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo. As a result, I'm happier today.
teaching.es: Gracias a esa decisión conocí a Leo. Como resultado, hoy soy más feliz.
teaching.explanationEs: Thanks to + causa; as a result + efecto.
segments: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo.
As a result, I'm happier today.
teaching.audioText: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo. As a result, I'm happier today.

teaching.en: Luckily, I changed my plans, and that's why I live here.
teaching.es: Por suerte cambié mis planes, y por eso vivo aquí.
teaching.explanationEs: Luckily expresa alivio; that's why introduce la consecuencia.
segments: Luckily, I changed my plans, and
that's why I live here.
teaching.audioText: Luckily, I changed my plans, and that's why I live here.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la timidez de hoy de Ana con lo que no hizo.

title.en: Weigh a choice with a friend
title.es: Sopesar una decisión con un amigo

es: Aconsejar a un amigo ante una decisión difícil con hipótesis sobre pasado y presente (If I were you…, If you had…) y responder a sus dudas.

teaching.en: The choice is hard, so I want to weigh the pros and cons.
teaching.es: La elección es difícil, así que quiero sopesar los pros y los contras.
